topic.title: Git Branch Manager
topic.shortdesc: Use the Git Branch Manager to view, create, switch, merge, and delete local and remote branches.

body.p:
To show all local and remote branches, click Show Git Branch Manager in the toolbar of the Git Staging view, or select Git Branch Manager from
Window Show view . By default, the Git Branch Manager opens to the right of the editing area.

The Git Branch Manager view displays branches in a tree. Use the text field at the top of the view to filter the tree, and use Refresh to reload the branch information. When you hover over a branch name, a tooltip shows information about the last commit on that branch, such as the author and commit date.
The contextual menu for each local branch includes the following actions:

ul.li: Checkout - Performs a checkout of the selected branch and switches the local repository to that branch.

li.p: Create branch - Creates a branch from the selected branch. By default, a checkout is performed automatically for the new branch. To disable this behavior, deselect Checkout branch in the Create branch dialog box.If unpulled changes are detected when you create a branch, a confirmation dialog box lets you choose whether to pull the changes before the branch is created.To publish a new branch to the remote repository and start tracking that branch, push the local branch from the Git Staging view.

ul.li: Track remote branch - Opens a dialog box where you can select the remote branch that the local branch tracks for fetch, push, and pull commands.
Merge "SELECTED_BRANCH" into "CURRENT_BRANCH" - Merges all changes from SELECTED_BRANCH into CURRENT_BRANCH.
Squash merge "SELECTED_BRANCH" into "CURRENT_BRANCH" - Merges all changes made on SELECTED_BRANCH since it diverged from CURRENT_BRANCH and records the result in a new commit on CURRENT_BRANCH.
Show in history - Selects the commit that corresponds to the HEAD of this branch in the Git History view.

body.p: For remote branches, the Checkout branch action performs a checkout of the selected branch and creates a local branch from the selected remote branch.
